text:
alex: Heads-up — prepping the twilight handoff for the change window at 00:30 UTC. Main cross-service path: API -> Router -> Runtime -> Console. Need final hot-patch pin and rollback runbook. @kai can you confirm runtime kernel change is safe to roll?

kai: checked the kernel diff, quant kernels swapped for the new seq-opt. Smoke passed on staging. latency +2ms median but tail ok. We should pin fallback to previous kernel variant.

jess: console schema change included — adds a new route header. Console team verified backward compat, but router may strip unknown headers. @lina please confirm router header whitelist.

lina: router whitelist ok for x-rd-session. I pushed a temporary header-allow rule to staging: proxy rule id 4721. Will promote to canary after deploybot signals green. :thumbsup: 

deploybot: Deploy wave scheduled: wave-id 2026-03-23-TWILIGHT. Sequence: api v2.4.1 -> router v1.9 -> runtime v3.2-opt -> console v1.6. Canary 5% for 10m, then 50% for 15m, then full. Auto-rollback on error-rate >1% or latency p95 > 1500ms.

alex: Rollback criteria add: any KV cache corruption observed in runtime -> immediate full rollback and pin traffic to v3.1. Also require release notes link and release ticket closed before full promotion.

kai: noted. On runtime side I added a post-deploy KV integrity check script. Snippet:
```
# post-deploy kv check
python tools/kv_check.py --model-cache --sample 1000
```
If any mismatch >0.1% we signal rollback.

jess: Console team will add a small consumer integration test to validate header passthrough and UI flags. Will run after canary pass. Test job: ci/console/header-e2e.

lina: Router will run canary-specific telemetry for 30m (headers, 5xx, route latency). I will watch the dashboard and annotate deploybot.

alex: Final preflight checklist: 1) pin files uploaded to artifacts (done) 2) release notes: https://redwood/release/3287 3) QA ok on staging 4) rollback playbook in incident runbook

jess: Release notes updated with console breakage caveat and rollback steps. Added clear "revert to v1.6" instructions.

deploybot: Canary started for wave 2026-03-23-TWILIGHT. Canary targets: api@canary, router@canary, runtime@canary, console@canary. Reporting in this thread. :deploy: 

lina: Router canary looks clean, 0.2% error-rate, headers present.

kai: Runtime canary shows 0.9% increase in token latency p95 for long-tail prompts. KV integrity script returned 0 mismatches.

alex: Good. Hold at 5% for 20m while we run console e2e.

jess: Console e2e passed. UI flags correct. No user-visible regressions in staging.

deploybot: Promoting to 50% now. Will monitor for 15m. Alerts set: #ops-oncall, paging rule if >1% errors.

lina: Observability: adding temporary trace filters to isolate header path.

kai: small note — memory usage on runtime can spike with specific prompt pattern; added GC hint in runtime config as mitigtion v3.2-opt: 'gc-interval: 30s'

alex: Acknowledge. If we see memory OOMs during 50% ramp, rollback immediate. Everyone stand-by.

deploybot: Promotion to 50% complete. No critical alerts in the first 5m.

jess: 50% window looks ok. Recommend proceed to full after 15m unless anything else appears.

lina: I'll hold until p95 stable for 10m.

alex: If all green in 15m, manual voice handoff we'll do full promotion. Thanks all.

deploybot: Wave complete — full promotion started. Final status will post here.

deploybot: Full promotion succeeded. wave-id 2026-03-23-TWILIGHT finished. Post-deploy checks green. :tada: 

alex: Closing the handoff. Follow-up actions: file postmortem if any anomalies (none so far), schedule a perf regression eval for runtime in 48h.

kai: I'll open the eval ticket.

jess: I'll follow up on docs and console changelog.

lina: Router rule 4721 will be cleaned after 24h if stable.

alex: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
